name: Columbia County, NY
findings: Columbia County has 275 nonprofit organizations. 130 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 106 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Columbia County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 18 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Columbia County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Columbia County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
